description: A hub of rooms, one for each piece of the game's cut content brought back: its enemies, props, pickups, lights and the heroes' unused bodies. Walk up to a door and its sign tells you what is behind it. To get there, take the warp in front of King Jeff's house; the hub's exit brings you back. Uses Restored Content, which is installed with it.
name: Restored Content Gallery
shortDescription: A hub of rooms showing every cut enemy, prop, pickup and light. Warp in front of King Jeff's house.
